requirements.title: Terminal Launch Flow UI
requirements.description: Terminal launcher dialog presents configurable agent and Empty Shell cards. Selecting a card is review-only until the separate submit action. Model and source controls appear only for a selected agent. The custom-command input is visible only with no card selected, and its draft survives selecting then clearing a card.

validation.notes: Launcher modal open/close, empty shell, shortcut selection, custom command, isCreating states

validation.ref: ui/src/__tests__/terminal-launcher.test.tsx:selects an agent without launching and launches it only after explicit submission
validation.notes: Agent card selection does not launch; submit sends the selected command

validation.ref: ui/src/__tests__/terminal-launcher.test.tsx:shows the selected agent's policy-backed source and model and submits that exact choice
validation.notes: Policy provenance, explicit source/model override, and native launch model are covered

validation.ref: ui/src/__tests__/terminal-launcher.test.tsx:preserves the custom command draft when a card is selected and cleared
validation.notes: Custom input is hidden while selected and restored with its draft after clear

BAS case executes custom-command launcher path to create terminal session and run command

requirements.title: Configurable Shortcut Entries
requirements.description: Shortcut entries are configurable via API. The default Claude shortcut uses `vrooli agent launch --runner claude --arg=--dangerously-skip-permissions`, and the Codex shortcut uses `codex --yolo`. Selecting an agent shortcut records its command; explicit submission creates the session with that command.

validation.notes: Default shortcuts include claude and codex per PRD
ShortcutEntry interface supports label, command, description
API-driven shortcut loading, fallback to defaults on API failure, prop override

requirements.title: Shortcut Session Creation
requirements.description: Submitting a selected agent shortcut creates a new session with the shortcut's command. Empty Shell uses the same session API without an agent command.

validation.notes: Create session API accepts optional shell command parameter
